steps.text: All 3 tests pass. I updated `parse_duration` in `duration.py` to use a regex that finds all unit components (hours, minutes, seconds) in the string and sums their contributions in seconds. This handles cases like `'1h30m'` (5400 seconds) while still supporting `'45s'` and `'2h'`.
